import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}
M = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()

    shared_strings = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall(M + "si"):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(M + "t"))
            shared_strings.append(text)
    print("SHARED STRINGS (%d):" % len(shared_strings))
    for i, s in enumerate(shared_strings):
        print("  [%d] %r" % (i, s))
    print()

    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    print("=== SHEET: Budget (xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml) ===")
    for row in root.iter(M + "row"):
        r = row.get("r")
        cells = []
        for c in row.findall(M + "c"):
            ref = c.get("r")
            t = c.get("t")
            v = c.find(M + "v")
            isel = c.find(M + "is")
            raw = v.text if v is not None else None
            if t == "s" and raw is not None:
                val = shared_strings[int(raw)]
            elif t == "inlineStr" and isel is not None:
                val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in isel.iter(M + "t"))
            else:
                val = raw
            cells.append("%s=%r" % (ref, val))
        print("  row %s: %s" % (r, " | ".join(cells)))

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

rows = {}
for row in root.iter(M + "row"):
    r = int(row.get("r"))
    cells = {}
    for c in row.findall(M + "c"):
        ref = c.get("r")
        col = "".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
        v = c.find(M + "v")
        cells[col] = v.text if v is not None else None
    rows[r] = cells

total = 0.0
items = []
for r in range(11, 23):
    val = rows[r]["C"]
    if val is None:
        continue
    num = float(val)
    total += num
    items.append((rows[r]["A"], rows[r]["B"], num))

for cat, name, num in items:
    print(f"{cat:15s} | {name:15s} | {num}")
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES: {total}")
